entities.name: La Hoguette culture
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: La Hoguette culture is an Early Neolithic ceramic archeological culture dating to approximately 5400–5000 BCE, though radiocarbon dating remains uncertain. The culture derives its name from the site of La Hoguette in Calvados, Normandy.
